ws_space_policy.title: Space Policies
values: Rooms marked 'executive reserved' in Notes are excluded from consolidation analysis regardless of utilization levels. These spaces serve strategic functions.
Rooms marked 'DECOMMISSIONED' in Notes are permanently closed and must be excluded from all utilization analysis and consolidation reporting. They are not available for reassignment.
